edges.root_basis:
The earliest Lyon printing recorded here, and the record starts here. Nothing behind it is carried.

THE BOOK ITSELF SAYS SOMETHING STANDS BEHIND IT, and that is now on the record
rather than absent from it. Its colophon calls the printing `novissime
impressum quod ab omnibus retro impressoribus i[n]castigatum evasit` -- newly
printed, having come uncorrected from all the printers before it [verified
2026-08-02 in the page image of canvas f439]. That is the book asserting earlier
Lyon printings it does not name. No edge is drawn to any of them, because none
has been located, and this stays a root: guidance/recensions.md Rule 4, silence
because nothing was established. What changed is that the silence is now KNOWN
to be a gap rather than possibly an origin.
